title: Custom Rigid Gift Boxes Canada RFQ Preparation Source Card
checklist: Prepare exact box dimensions, product weight and product fit requirements.
Define the structure: lift-off lid, magnetic closure, drawer, folding rigid box or set packaging.
Clarify insert/tray requirements, print direction, finish, logo placement and unboxing style.
Ask for mockup, sample or pre-production confirmation before full production.
Review public product pages and buyer-source pages before requesting a quote.
prompt: For a Canada B2B buyer looking for custom rigid gift boxes, what should a buyer prepare before requesting a quote or RFQ, and which public source pages are useful? Cite sources.
